objective: 建立可版本化、状态驱动、可查询且可扩展的统一业务表单元数据模型。
non_goals: 将所有业务字段改为 EAV
实现动态表单 API 或前端页面
修改现有业务逻辑、Java 包名或既有迁移
decisions: Keep core identity, status, relation, audit and high-frequency query fields in business tables.
Store configurable fields through scope, section, field definition, rule, option and value tables.
Use typed value columns and reserve JSON for explicitly declared structured fields.
Use status/role/expression condition keys instead of display labels in field rules.
Record published configuration snapshots for traceability and rollback.
risks: The new schema is a public platform contract and needs owner review before API implementation.
Large-scale extension-field reporting requires query allowlists and dedicated indexes.
The migration was syntax-checked locally but needs a MySQL 8.4 startup migration check before release.
